content_sections.heading: NeGD Co-Lead Job Description
content_sections.text: The Co-Lead positions involve heading specialized strategic functional domains, spearheading large-scale nationwide digital interventions, handholding Central Ministries and State/UT Governments, collaborating with industry, academia, and startups, and driving proactive Business Development and institutional partnerships for NeGD services and digital public platforms. Co-Lead – Digital Transformation & Strategy: Establish digital governance roadmap, draft techno-legal frameworks, provide technical and process advisory, handle solution architecture, monitor digital governance projects, provide cross-tech advisory (AI, Cloud, IoT, GIS), lead business development, conduct stakeholder engagement, and create procurement advisory models. Co-Lead – Digital Infrastructure & Cyber Security: Advise ministries on cyber security policies and incident response, support secure cloud and infrastructure adoption, facilitate new engagements for advisory services, review DPRs and security architectures, draft RFPs and SLAs for security services, and plan cyber security capacity building initiatives. Co-Lead – Emerging Technologies: Lead technical conceptualization and pilot development of AI/ML and Generative AI applications, integrate cross-disciplinary emerging technologies (Blockchain, IoT, Drones/GIS), engage with ministries for emerging tech deployments, define ethical AI frameworks, organize hackathons, and appraise AI/ML DPRs. Co-Lead – Data Analytics & Business Intelligence (BI): Architect and oversee Big Data analytics platforms and data lakes, define enterprise data integration and ETL/ELT pipelines, direct rollout of executive BI dashboards, lead business development for analytics requirements, establish data governance protocols, and formulate model RFPs for Big Data platforms.
